say:1:1530115401:0.text: Since the Herdmaster fell, her blessing is no more. Hunting will be harder now.
say:1:1530115401:0.source_cn: 兽群之主陨落之后，没了她的赐福，狩猎可能会变困难。
say:1:1530115401:0.male: Since the Herdmaster fell, her blessing is no more. Hunting will be harder now.
say:1:1530115401:0.female: Since the Herdmaster fell, her blessing is no more. Hunting will be harder now.

say:2:1530115402:0.text: If we don't bring back enough game, people will go hungry. That's no small thing.
say:2:1530115402:0.source_cn: 打不到足够的猎物，就会有人饿肚子，那可不是什么好事。
say:2:1530115402:0.male: If we don't bring back enough game, people will go hungry. That's no small thing.
say:2:1530115402:0.female: If we don't bring back enough game, people will go hungry. That's no small thing.
